info.title: CPMigrate — NuGet Central Package Management Migration & Dependency Analysis CLI
info.description: Migrate .NET solutions to NuGet Central Package Management (CPM). Generate Directory.Packages.props, analyze dependency health (version drift, transitive conflicts, vulnerabilities), auto-fix package issues, unify Directory.Build.props, and update NuGet packages with test verification and rollback — including --bisect to keep the largest green subset.

options.name: --solution
options.description:
Path to a .sln/.slnx file, or a directory
containing one. When omitted, CPMigrate uses the
current directory.

options.name: --project
options.description:
Path to a specific project file, or a directory
containing one project (.csproj, .fsproj, .vbproj).

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: (Default: .) The props file output directory.

options.name: --keep-attrs
options.description:
(Default: false) Keeps the 'Version' attribute in
the project files.

options.name: --no-backup
options.description:
(Default: false) Disables the default backup
option.

options.name: --backup-dir
options.description:
(Default: .) The backup directory for project files
about to be changed.

options.name: --add-gitignore
options.description:
(Default: false) Adds the backup directory to
.gitignore file. Creates one if not present.

options.name: --gitignore-dir
options.description:
(Default: .) The directory for .gitignore file if
there isn't one existing.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
(Default: false) Preview changes without modifying
any files.

options.name: --merge
options.description:
(Default: false) Merge into existing
Directory.Packages.props instead of failing if it
already exists.

options.name: --conflict-strategy
options.description:
(Default: Highest) How to handle version conflicts:
Highest (default), Lowest, or Fail.

options.name: --rollback
options.description:
(Default: false) Restore project files from most
recent backup and remove Directory.Packages.props.

options.name: --analyze
options.description:
(Default: false) Analyze packages for issues
(version inconsistencies, duplicates, redundant
references) without modifying files.

options.name: --transitive
options.description:
(Default: false) Include transitive dependencies in
analysis and migration suggestions (requires
'dotnet restore').

options.name: --audit
options.description:
(Default: false) Perform security audit for known
vulnerabilities (requires 'dotnet restore').

options.name: --outdated
options.description:
(Default: false) Include outdated package checks
(requires --analyze).

options.name: --deprecated
options.description: (Default: false) Include deprecated package checks

options.name: --fail-on
options.description:
(Default: Info) Lowest finding severity that fails
the build: Info (default, any finding), Low,
Moderate, High, Critical, or Never to report
without gating. Does not suppress exit 8 for an
incomplete scan.

options.name: --explain
options.description:
Explain a rule and exit: pass a rule ID (e.g.
VersionInconsistency) or 'all' to list every rule.
Rule IDs appear in JSON issueCode and SARIF ruleId.

options.name: --max-parallelism
options.description:
Maximum projects scanned at once. Defaults to the
processor count, capped at 8 because each scan
shells out to 'dotnet package list'. Use 1 to scan
serially.

options.name: --completions
options.description:
Print a shell completion script and exit: Bash,
Zsh, Fish, or PowerShell. Generated from the option
list, so it cannot go stale.

options.name: --baseline
options.description:
Path to a baseline file of accepted findings.
Findings it records are still reported but do not
fail the build, so a repository with existing debt
can gate on new problems only. Requires a path; set
"baseline" in .cpmigrate.json to apply it to every
run.

options.name: --write-baseline
options.description:
(Default: false) Record the current findings as the
accepted baseline instead of gating on them, then
exit. Writes to --baseline when given, otherwise
.cpmigrate-baseline.json.

options.name: --interactive
options.description:
(Default: false) Run in interactive wizard mode
with guided prompts.

options.name: --output
options.description:
(Default: Terminal) Output format: Terminal
(default), Json for CI/CD integration, Sarif for
GitHub code scanning, or Markdown for a CI job
summary or PR comment. Sarif and Markdown require

options.name: --output-file
options.description:
Write output to file instead of stdout (only
applies to Json and Sarif output).

options.name: --quiet
options.description:
(Default: false) Suppress non-essential output
(progress bars, spinners). Useful for scripts.

options.name: --verbose
options.description:
(Default: false) Enable verbose diagnostic logging
to a file (cpmigrate.log in current directory).

options.name: --batch
options.description:
Scan directory recursively for .sln files and
process each.

options.name: --batch-parallel
options.description:
(Default: false) Process solutions in parallel
(default: sequential).

options.name: --batch-continue
options.description:
(Default: false) Continue processing even if one
solution fails.

options.name: --prune-backups
options.description:
(Default: false) Delete old backups, keeping only
the most recent based on --retention.

options.name: --prune-all
options.description:
(Default: false) Delete ALL backups (requires
confirmation unless --quiet is set).

options.name: --retention
options.description:
(Default: 5) Number of backups to keep when pruning
(default: 5, 0 = keep all).

options.name: --list-backups
options.description:
(Default: false) List all available backups with
timestamps and file counts.

options.name: --interactive-conflicts
options.description:
(Default: false) Prompt for each version conflict
instead of auto-resolving.

options.name: --unify-props
options.description:
(Default: false) Migrate common properties from
projects to Directory.Build.props.

options.name: --force
options.description:
(Default: false) Force operations without
confirmation prompts.

options.name: --fix
options.description:
(Default: false) Apply automatic fixes for detected
issues (use with --analyze).

options.name: --fix-dry-run
options.description:
(Default: false) Show what --fix would change
without modifying files.

options.name: --update
options.description:
(Default: false) Check for and install the latest
version of CPMigrate.

options.name: --update-packages
options.description:
(Default: false) Update all packages to latest
versions, run tests, rollback on failure.

options.name: --include-prerelease
options.description:
(Default: false) Include pre-release versions when
updating packages.

options.name: --bisect
options.description:
(Default: false) On test failure, bisect the update
set and keep the largest subset that stays green
instead of rolling everything back.

options.name: --bisect-budget
options.description:
Maximum restore+test cycles a bisection may spend
before holding back what is left. Defaults to 16.

options.name: --bisect-test-filter
options.description:
dotnet test --filter expression used for each
bisection probe, to narrow the search to a fast
subset of the suite.

options.name: --only
options.description: Comma-separated package IDs to restrict

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.
